title: Bowman Debuts at #14 on BD+C’s Top Engineering Firms List
summary: Bowman debuts on BD+C's 2026 Top Engineering Firms list, marking its first appearance in the publication’s Giants 400 Report.
body_markdown:
Bowman has made its debut in Building Design+Construction’s (BD+C) 2026 Giants 400 Report, ranking #14 on the publication’s[Top 80 Engineering Firms list](https://www.bdcnetwork.com/giants-400/article/55399606/top-80-engineering-firms-for-2026) . The first-time placement recognizes Bowman among the nation’s leading engineering firms serving nonresidential building and multifamily housing markets.


Now in its 50th year, BD+C’s annual Giants 400 Report benchmarks the nation’s largest architecture, engineering and construction firms based on qualifying buildings-related revenue. Nearly 600 firms participated in the 2026 report, which includes rankings across a broad range of building sectors, specialties and AEC disciplines.


Bowman also debuted at #40 on BD+C’s[Top 400 Building Design Firms list](https://www.bdcnetwork.com/giants-400/article/55400461/top-400-building-design-firms-for-2026) , further establishing the company’s position among the nation’s leading firms supporting the built environment. Together, the rankings underscore the scale of Bowman’s building design capabilities and growing presence in markets nationwide.


Bowman’s strong first showing reflects the continued growth of our engineering practice and investment in multidisciplinary expertise. Across civil, structural and MEP engineering, commissioning and specialized building services, our teams bring together complementary capabilities to address complex project needs and deliver greater value for clients.


The recognition marks another milestone in Bowman’s continued growth and reinforces the strength of an increasingly integrated national platform built to serve clients across disciplines, markets and geographies.
